data: Which line represents the model with the highest accuracy at 1 million parallel sentences in the middle right plot?

The question asks which line represents the model with the highest accuracy at 1 million parallel sentences in the middle right plot. From the caption, we know that the legend shows the average accuracies of each model using 1M parallel sentences. The lines in the figure represent different models, and their positions on the y-axis indicate their accuracy. 

Looking at the legend, the line labeled "SDAE/NMT (joint)" is shown in green and has the highest position on the y-axis among all the lines. This indicates that the SDAE/NMT (joint) model has the highest accuracy at 1 million parallel sentences. Therefore, the answer is the green line.
